verdict.rationale: Shortcut's Iterations are its first-party sprint feature: they let teams prioritize and track week-to-week work. Its automations cover sprint management by auto-creating future Iterations and moving unfinished Stories into the next Iteration, and WIP limits per workflow state support in-sprint flow. Together these cover both planning and managing sprints. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of sprint planning mechanics (capacity, velocity, burndown or sprint reporting), and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing and pricing pages.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can plan and manage sprints for agile software development

citations.quote: Quickly prioritize and keep track of the work your team needs to be focused on week-to-week with Iterations.
